restaurantName: Haughton Hall Hotel and Leisure Club
bio: Nestled in the quiet beauty of rural Shropshire, dating from 1718, Haughton Hall has been decorated with timeless style and situated in 35 acres of gardens a beautiful setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  You can enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea which includes freshly made sandwiches, scones, cakes and fancies plus your choice of Speciality Tea's or Coffee.
pageTitle: Haughton Hall Hotel and Leisure Club
